svg.text: Learning card box A7 – assembly instructions
Sanduku la kadi za kujifunzia A7 – maelekezo ya kuunganisha
Leitner box, 5 compartments · corrugated cardboard 3.0 mm · outside 386 × 121 × 50 mm
Parts per box · Vipande kwa kila sanduku
KKP angles, strip 30 mm wide · pembe za KKP, upana mm 30
Kisu kikali (cutter) na vipande vya akiba
· Steel ruler, square, pencil, cutting board
Rula ya chuma, pembemraba, penseli, ubao mnene wa kukatia
· Bone folder or blunt knife back for folding
Kifaa cha kukunja au mgongo butu wa kisu
· Spray adhesive, newspaper to cover the table
Gundi ya kunyunyiza, magazeti ya kufunika meza
Kadibodi ya mawimbi ya kahawia, karatasi ya kadi 205 g
